title: BLACKOUT AT SITE-7
subtitle: First Signal
synopsis: A research site vanished from the network 19 minutes after reporting a sealed containment breach. ASTER, ROOK and MICA are sent to recover the missing team ledger, identify the source of the blackout and extract before the site's auxiliary reactor fails.

briefing.speaker: COMMAND
briefing.text: Site-7 dropped off the grid after a containment alarm. No evacuation beacon followed.

briefing.speaker: MICA
briefing.text: The last telemetry packet contains a signal that does not match any facility transmitter.

briefing.speaker: ROOK
briefing.text: So we go in, find the missing team, and make sure whatever caused it stays inside.

briefing.speaker: ASTER
briefing.text: Primary objective: recover the archive ledger. Secondary: identify the source. Extraction takes priority if the reactor warning goes red.

post_mission.speaker: MICA
post_mission.text: The recovered ledger confirms the blackout was triggered from inside Containment Core C.

post_mission.speaker: COMMAND
post_mission.text: And the unknown carrier signal is still transmitting. Site-7 was not an isolated failure.
